i1b_min_pi: We collect only identifiers necessary to provision accounts and bill customers.
i4b_sources: Directly from account signup and product telemetry.

a6_safeguards.harm: (A) Unauthorized access, destruction, use, modification, or disclosure
a6_safeguards.safeguard: The analytics service account is scoped to the measurement views only, credentials rotate every 30 days, and exports are logged and reviewed weekly.

a6_safeguards.harm: (C) Impairment of consumer control over personal information
a6_safeguards.safeguard: The notice at collection is being amended to name IP-derived approximate location and the telemetry SDK default is being disabled.

subject_anchor: California consumers using the free tier

a2_necessity_set.justification: The email address is the account identifier used to authenticate the free-tier session that the usage measurement is attributed to; without it no measurement can be tied to an account.
The cookie ID distinguishes repeat sessions from first sessions, which is the measurement the activity exists to produce.

a2_necessity_set.element: Approximate location derived from IP address
a2_necessity_set.necessity: Collected but not necessary to the stated purpose
a2_necessity_set.justification: Location is captured by the telemetry SDK's defaults and is not used in any usage-measurement output.

a5_harm_pathways.harm: (A) Unauthorized access, destruction, use, modification, or disclosure
a5_harm_pathways.cause: An over-broad analytics service-account credential could be reused outside the measurement pipeline and export the joined table.
a5_harm_pathways.source: The telemetry event store, which holds account email addresses joined to device identifiers, is readable by the analytics service account.

a5_harm_pathways.harm: (C) Impairment of consumer control over personal information
a5_harm_pathways.cause: A consumer reading the notice cannot tell that IP-derived location is retained, so the opt-out choice is made on an incomplete description.
a5_harm_pathways.source: The free-tier signup notice describes telemetry collection but does not name the derived approximate-location field.

a4_benefit_public: No public benefit is claimed for this activity beyond the consumer benefit stated above.
has_secondary_uses: No — this data is used for this activity only
a4_benefit_business: Free-tier usage measurement tells the engineering team which onboarding step free-tier accounts abandon, which is the input to the quarterly onboarding rework decision.
a4_benefit_consumer: Consumers reach a working configuration faster because the abandoned onboarding steps identified by this measurement are the ones rewritten first.
q10_id_verification: Documented verification process matching CPPA guidance
i1_processing_purpose: Deliver core SaaS analytics functionality to enterprise customers with role-based access controls in place.
q15b_under16_knowledge: No — we do not knowingly process under-16 data
i7_internal_contributors: Privacy Officer; Head of Engineering; Data Platform Lead.
primary_activity_purpose: We analyse free-tier account and device identifiers to measure product usage.
a4_benefit_other_stakeholders: Enterprise administrators who sponsor free-tier trials receive accurate seat-activation reporting instead of estimates when deciding whether to convert a trial.
